name: BSP_PeerManager_PumpMessageQueues
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_session_polls, read-only analysis. __fastcall(void* peer) with ECX = game+1EF0h, ret at 0077648a. Returns at once when 00e188a8 is null. Picks the network object as peer+188h if set else peer+18Ch, then drains two locked queues on it: the 12-byte list at net+28h (head +2Ch, count +30h, CS +34h) running 00774ab0, 007752d0 and 007717a0 on each node[2]; and the list at net+18h (head +1Ch, count +20h, CS +24h) running 007702e0 when node[2]+D50h is set, then 00772ec0. The pseudocode shows a return after the first node, but the listing at 007762ff-00776309 falls into jmp 00776286, so each queue is drained fully. Between the queues, when peer+F4h is set, 01090ab0 virtual +20h gives a {counter, frequency} pair and a gap over 00d7a348 since 00e0af18 runs 00784c40 and 007850e0. Only reachable from BSP_Game_OnMove through the drain loop at 004e5462 that the decompiler removed as unreachable. See docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md.

name: BSP_Multiplayer_Tick
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_session_polls, read-only analysis. __fastcall(void* peer, float seconds) with ECX = game+1EF0h and RET 4 at 00778582. Body is two calls: 00778450(peer, seconds) at 0077856b and 0076ffc0(peer, seconds, 0) at 0077857c, with ECX restored from ESI. Sole caller BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e5036 with the raw frame delta; the call is skipped when the state is 0Dh, 00f876b0 >= 1 and the scaled delta is positive. See docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md.

name: BSP_Session_RouteMessage
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_unit_orders_apply, read-only analysis. void __thiscall(session = ECX, message = [esp+4], ...), body 0077C2A0..0077C469. Ghidra's pseudocode is wrong: it renders ECX as param_1 and the message as unaff_retaddr/unaff_EDI. Assembly 0077C2AB MOV EDI,ECX and 0077C2D0 MOV EBP,[ESP+18h] give the real binding. Requires game+5D4h >= 0Ah; derives routing flags from DAT_00E0AF1C and game+1FE4h, stamps msg+18h from sender+174h, sends to non-local peers through 00770B50 when hosting, and on the local bit calls 0076E520 to push the message into the session's own receive queue. 131 callers. docs/UNIT_STATE_MESSAGE.md

name: BSP_Session_DeliverEntitySyncMessage
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_unit_orders_apply, read-only analysis. void __thiscall(entity, message*), RET 4 (0077C7A2), body 0077C710..0077C7A2. Gated on entity+5Eh == 0. Walks the list at entity+2A4h for the node whose +8 equals msg+14h, rejects when msg+0Ch is behind the node's 16-bit tick by less than 7531h, stores the tick and calls entity->vtable[18Ch](msg) at 0077C79B. ECX comes from 00521E30 on the 16-bit id at msg+18h. Ghidra's stl_probable tag is a misclassification. docs/UNIT_STATE_MESSAGE.md
